requiredInputs.accessToken: IAM/appbase session token through the shared TokenManager; never a VITE_* variable

modeSelection.rule: hosted only when agentsApiBaseUrl is non-empty and an access token is present; never a silent offline fallback

acceptance: A real hosted conversation transcript is recorded for at least one non-emergency symptom.
An emergency red flag returned by the hosted agent still yields TriageLevel.emergency and is never softened.
The Me tab shows the active mode and never claims hosted when the offline adapter is running.
blockedUntil: An agents API base URL and an IAM access token are provisioned in the target deployment profile.
